title: Claim Re-scoping and Scientific Contract

claims.claim: Real MIMIC-IV preprocessing into ICU code sequences
claims.evidence: data/processed/mimiciv_*.pkl (~380k train admissions, vocab ~47k); src/preprocessing/extract_mimiciv.py; mimiciv_split_manifest.json

claims.claim: The synthetic benchmark measures real anomaly reasoning, not injection artifacts
claims.evidence: Phase 1a diagnostic: demographic_conflict 0.94 recoverable by a single sex-specific-token indicator; medication_mismatch 0.72 by sequence length; detector is supervised on the same scheme

claims.claim: Supervised detector achieves ROC-AUC ~0.80 on the synthetic benchmark
claims.required_fix: Number is real; meaning limited by C2b. Re-evaluate non-circularly in Phase 3

claims.evidence: artifacts/day41/day41_ablation_summary.json: full 0.80097 vs detector-only 0.80022 (delta ~0.0008, no significance test); best variant no_generative
claims.required_fix: Phase 2 + Phase 3; reframe as interpretability not ranking gain

claims.claim: Real SNOMED CT / RxNorm ontology integration
claims.evidence: ontologies/ contains only .gitkeep; live scoring uses hardcoded ICD-prefix rules (src/ontology/rules.py); real-SNOMED engine (loader.py/engine.py) disconnected and imports undefined rule classes
claims.required_fix: Phase 2: acquire UMLS/SNOMED/RxNorm, run parsers, consolidate engines, wire into scoring

claims.evidence: src/scoring/ontology_aware.py uses a normalized weighted sum with w_gen=0.0 default and sgen hardcoded to 0; additive identity not realized
claims.required_fix: Phase 3 defensible scoring; drop additive-identity framing

claims.claim: Diffusion-based generative surprise Sgen separates anomalies
claims.evidence: artifacts/day34/day34_generative_eval_summary.json: Sgen ROC-AUC 0.475 (worse than random); anomaly mean < normal mean
claims.required_fix: Phase 5 decision gate (multi-sample Sgen); cut unless gate passes

claims.claim: Diffusion model generates realistic EHR sequences
claims.evidence: generated length ~254 vs real ~47; 127 of 4587 tokens used (mode collapse); JS 0.27
src/explanations/counterfactual.py is a rule-based edit search; diffusion model never invoked
claims.required_fix: Phase 4; generative variant only if Phase 5 passes

claims.evidence: edits drawn from injection answer-key columns (bad_code/expected_code/replacement_code) and scored by the same rules: circular
claims.required_fix: Phase 4: leakage-free ontology-neighborhood edits, independent scorer
Phase 7 clinician review; frame as preliminary until then

claims.evidence: Headline novelties C5-C10 unsupported or circular today
claims.required_fix: Phases 1-4; re-anchor novelty on leakage-free ontology counterfactuals + non-circular benchmark

claims.claim: Demographic metadata available for sex/age anomaly reasoning
claims.evidence: gender, age_group present in *_synth_anomaly.pkl; but demographic rules infer sex from token presence (circular)
claims.required_fix: Phase 1b/2: use real gender/age_group fields not token inference

claims.evidence: Disciplined per-day artifacts + tests; but absolute D:\Article paths baked into artifacts; some metrics from pre-baked CSVs not live pipeline

future_work_only: generative surprise and diffusion repair if Phase 5 gate fails

diffusion_decision: Provisionally demoted to diagnostic-only; promoted back to a contribution only if Phase 5 gate passes (multi-sample Sgen ROC-AUC >= 0.65 AND realistic samples JS <= 0.10, vocab coverage >= 60%).
